name: Delivery
description: Stack-agnostic web-development delivery process. Work moves left to right through the stages; the **policy gates** below enforce that each stage's exit criteria are met before a task advances, and the **suggestion policies** remind you of the conventions. Set the boolean fields (`spec_approved`, `plan_approved`, `tests_passing`, `review_cleared`, `audited`) as each gate is satisfied.

groups.name: Spec
groups.description: Defining behavior, data, edge cases, and acceptance criteria.

groups.name: Plan
groups.description: Implementation approach, task breakdown, and test strategy.

groups.name: In Progress
groups.description: Building the change with tests, on a feature branch.

groups.name: Code Review
groups.description: A reviewer is checking correctness, security, and conventions.

groups.name: QA
groups.description: Manual / browser verification plus the full automated suite on a clean database.

groups.name: Done
groups.description: Merged. Tested, reviewed, audited, docs in sync.

policies.name: Spec approved before planning
policies.description: A task cannot move from Spec to Plan until its spec is approved.

definition.on_failure_message: Move blocked: the spec must be approved before planning. Set custom_data.spec_approved = true once the spec is signed off.

policies.name: Plan approved before building
policies.description: A task cannot move from Plan to In Progress until its plan is approved.

definition.on_failure_message: Move blocked: the plan must be approved before building. Set custom_data.plan_approved = true once the plan is signed off.

policies.name: Tests pass before review
policies.description: A task cannot move from In Progress to Code Review until its tests pass.

definition.on_failure_message: Move blocked: the automated suite must be green (zero failures) before review. Set custom_data.tests_passing = true.

policies.name: Review cleared before QA
policies.description: A task cannot move from Code Review to QA until the review is cleared.

definition.on_failure_message: Move blocked: the reviewer must clear all blockers before QA. Set custom_data.review_cleared = true.

policies.name: Done requires tests + review + audit
policies.description: Nothing reaches Done from any stage without a green suite, a cleared review, and a recorded audit.

definition.on_failure_message: Move blocked: Done requires a green suite (tests_passing), a cleared review (review_cleared), and a recorded audit (audited). Set all three to true.

policies.name: Write tests during development
policies.description: Reminds the agent of build-time conventions while a task is In Progress.

definition.message: Write/update tests alongside the code — during development, not after. Keep lint, format, type-check, and the build clean, and use small logical commits that explain *why*.

policies.name: Keep docs in sync for user-facing work
policies.description: Fires on any write to a user-facing task.

definition.message: User-facing change: update the spec and the user-facing docs before Done. Treat doc drift as a blocker.

policies.name: Definition of done
policies.description: Surfaces the full done checklist while a task is in QA.

definition.message: Definition of done before moving to Done: full suite green (zero failures); lint/format/type-check/build clean; review cleared; acceptance criteria met; docs in sync; no secrets committed; audit recorded (set audited = true).
